title: Does Hot Water Freeze Faster Than Cold Water?
summary: Sciencium examines the Mpemba effect, the claim that hot water freezes faster than cold water. It walks through experiments and a published paper questioning the effect.
why: HN cites it as a concise rundown of why the Mpemba effect likely does not hold up.

quote.text: walking through all the experiments that demonstrate the effect does not in fact exist.
